title: Badshahi Mosque
credits: Photos: Saqib Rubab, Jamshaid Mughal, Hassaan Malik / Unsplash
lines: This is the Badshahi Mosque, in Lahore.
It was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb, and completed in sixteen seventy-three.
Built in red sandstone and crowned with white marble domes, it is one of the finest examples of Mughal architecture.
For centuries, it stood among the largest mosques in the world.
Today, it remains one of Lahore's proudest landmarks.
